sources.snippet: TDS GA5 — Simple Guides (Agentic AI week) These are my notes for GA5. Each question has its own file with the approach — not ready-made answers, because everyone's task is personalised (the grader seeds it from your email, so your maze, your prices, your file set are all different from mine).

sources.title: tds-ga5-guide/Q10.md at master · angadseth/tds-ga5-guide
sources.snippet: An A2A (Agent-to-Agent) 1.0 invoice agent. The grader sends a batch of invoice packages; you use any AI to read them, propose one action per invoice with cited evidence, wait for the grader's results, then execute only the accepted proposals and store the completed Task. Marks come from correct actions, real receipt handling, stored state, and protocol behaviour — not model names or token ...
